turns.speaker: unknown
turns.text: Harbor Federal Credit Union renewal Thu, Oct 22, 2026, 10:00AM • 9:22

turns.speaker: unknown
turns.text: [PERSON_1] 0:04 Morning everyone. How's the weather up in Tacoma today?

turns.speaker: unknown
turns.text: [PERSON_2] 0:09 Oh, you know, gray and drizzly. Classic October.

turns.speaker: unknown
turns.text: [PERSON_3] 0:12 Like, it's actually not bad. I got out for a walk at lunch yesterday and only got rained on once.

turns.speaker: unknown
turns.text: [PERSON_4] 0:21 Once is pretty good for us.

turns.speaker: unknown
turns.text: [PERSON_1] 0:24 Ha, fair. Well, thanks for making time. I know we're about four months out from your renewal, so I wanted to check in early, see how things are going, and talk through anything you want to flag before we you know, get into the formal stuff.

turns.speaker: unknown
turns.text: [PERSON_2] 0:42 Appreciate that. And yeah, we're... we're in a good place with the platform overall. But I'll be honest, I've got some pressure from our board on vendor spend this year. So I want to use this call to get ahead of that.

turns.speaker: unknown
turns.text: [PERSON_1] 0:57 Got it. Well, let's dig in. What's top of mind?

turns.speaker: unknown
turns.text: [PERSON_2] 1:02 So, a couple things. First, how's our usage looking? Are we actually using what we we pay for?

turns.speaker: unknown
turns.text: [PERSON_1] 1:10 Let me pull that up. So you're at forty-five seats on QM, and your call tracking volume is running about... twelve percent above where you were this time last year. Signal AI is processing everything, no issues there. QM adoption, though, that's where I see room. About sixty percent of your seats are active in a given month.

turns.speaker: unknown
turns.text: [PERSON_3] 1:35 Sixty percent. Huh. I thought it was higher.

turns.speaker: unknown
turns.text: [PERSON_4] 1:38 That's probably the branch teams. Uh, They've been slow to pick it up.

turns.speaker: unknown
turns.text: [PERSON_2] 1:45 Right, and that's part of my problem. If we're not using all the seats, the board's going to ask why we're paying I mean, for them.

turns.speaker: unknown
turns.text: [PERSON_1] 1:54 That's a a fair question. Can I ask what's driving the low adoption on the branch side? Is it training, or something else?

turns.speaker: unknown
turns.text: [PERSON_2] 2:05 Honestly, uh, it's a mix. Some of it is just bandwidth. We opened the Gig Harbor branch in August, and that's been a whole thing. Training fell by the wayside.

turns.speaker: unknown
turns.text: [PERSON_3] 2:16 The Gig Harbor opening was insane. We had a ribbon cutting, and and the first week we had like three times the call volume we projected.

turns.speaker: unknown
turns.text: [PERSON_1] 2:25 Oh wow. How's it settling in now?

turns.speaker: unknown
turns.text: [PERSON_3] 2:29 Better. It's calmed down. But those first few weeks were a lot of 'where do I park' calls.

turns.speaker: unknown
turns.text: [PERSON_2] 2:38 You know, Ha, yeah. Not exactly high-value conversations.

turns.speaker: unknown
turns.text: [PERSON_1] 2:43 So, well, congrats on getting it open. That's a big lift. And it makes sense that QM training slipped. Maybe we can talk about a refresh for those teams before renewal.

turns.speaker: unknown
turns.text: [PERSON_2] 2:57 Um, Maybe. But here's the thing, [PERSON_1]. QM was sold to us as part of the bundle and now it's a separate line at renewal. That's a hard conversation with our board.

turns.speaker: unknown
turns.text: [PERSON_1] 3:09 Okay. I hear that. Can you tell me a little more about how it's showing up on your end? Is it the line item itself, or the amount?

turns.speaker: unknown
turns.text: [PERSON_2] 3:21 Both, honestly. When we signed, it was all one number. Now I'm looking at a renewal quote that breaks out QM as its own thing, and it's not a small number. Our CFO is going to look at that and say, 'why are we paying extra for something we already had?'

turns.speaker: unknown
turns.text: [PERSON_1] 3:43 That's helpful context. I don't want to get into pricing on this call because I need to check a few things on my side, but I can take that back and see what options we have. Would it help if I put um, together a one-pager on QM usage and value that you could bring to the board?

turns.speaker: unknown
turns.text: [PERSON_2] 4:07 That would actually be really helpful. Something that shows what we're getting for it.

turns.speaker: unknown
turns.text: [PERSON_1] 4:14 Done. I'll have that to you by early next week. Um, now, [PERSON_3], you mentioned a couple of things when we set this up. Want to walk through those?

turns.speaker: unknown
turns.text: [PERSON_3] 4:26 Yeah, two things. One is the spam tagging issue. We're seeing, um, about one in ten of our Saturday calls are getting tagged as spam, and they're members calling about fraud alerts.

turns.speaker: unknown
turns.text: [PERSON_1] 4:38 That's That's a problem. Are these calls coming into a specific number or campaign?

turns.speaker: unknown
turns.text: [PERSON_3] 4:43 It's our main member services line. Saturday so, mornings, you know, mostly. The calls are real, members calling because they got a text about a suspicious charge. But Signal AI is flagging them as spam and they're not getting routed to the fraud team.

turns.speaker: unknown
turns.text: [PERSON_1] 5:00 Okay. And is that that a routing issue or a scoring issue? Like, I mean, are they getting the spam signal and then dropped?

turns.speaker: unknown
turns.text: [PERSON_3] 5:10 I think it's the signal. They're getting tagged before they even hit the IVR. So by the time the call flow tries to route, it's already marked as spam.

turns.speaker: unknown
turns.text: [PERSON_1] 5:22 Got it. I'll need to look at some examples. Can you send me a few call IDs from last Saturday?

turns.speaker: unknown
turns.text: [PERSON_3] 5:29 Yeah, I can pull those. I've got a list somewhere.

turns.speaker: unknown
turns.text: [PERSON_4] 5:33 I can grab them from Salesforce if you want. They're all logged there.

turns.speaker: unknown
turns.text: [PERSON_3] 5:39 Oh, right. Yeah, that's easier.

turns.speaker: unknown
turns.text: [PERSON_1] 5:42 Perfect. And [PERSON_4], I know you had something on the Salesforce side too. What's going on there?

turns.speaker: unknown
turns.text: [PERSON_4] 5:49 Um, yeah, so, the sync breaks every time we add a field to our Member [PATIENT_1] object. I've rebuilt the mapping three times since July.

turns.speaker: unknown
turns.text: [PERSON_1] 6:00 Three times. Okay. Can you walk me through what happens when it breaks?

turns.speaker: unknown
turns.text: [PERSON_4] 6:06 So we add a field, say we added a 'Preferred Contact Method' field in August, and then the next day the call records stop syncing. The mapping just... drops. I have to go back into the Invoca Salesforce integration and re-map everything.

turns.speaker: unknown
turns.text: [PERSON_1] 6:25 Uh, and this started in July?

turns.speaker: unknown
turns.text: [PERSON_4] 6:28 Uh, First time was July. Then again in August, and then just last week. It's not every field, but it's happened three you know, times now.

turns.speaker: unknown
turns.text: [PERSON_1] 6:38 Okay. I want to get our support team on this. Can you send me the case um, numbers if you have them? Or I can open a new one.

turns.speaker: unknown
turns.text: [PERSON_4] 6:48 I've got two open cases already. I can send you those.

turns.speaker: unknown
turns.text: [PERSON_1] 6:53 Great. And just so I understand, is this happening in your sandbox first, or is it going straight to production?

turns.speaker: unknown
turns.text: [PERSON_4] 7:01 Production. We don't have a sandbox for the Invoca integration. Well, we do, but it's not set up the same way.

turns.speaker: unknown
turns.text: [PERSON_1] 7:11 Okay, that's good to know. Um, I'll take this back with the cases and see if we can figure out what's happening. I don't want to guess at a cause on the call.

turns.speaker: unknown
turns.text: [PERSON_4] 7:24 Appreciate it. It's just frustrating. Every time I think it's fixed, we add another field and it breaks again.

turns.speaker: unknown
turns.text: [PERSON_1] 7:32 Totally get it. Let's get the cases in front of the right people. Now, anything else on your list?

turns.speaker: unknown
turns.text: [PERSON_2] 7:40 I think that's the big stuff. The QM pricing and the two technical issues.

turns.speaker: unknown
turns.text: [PERSON_3] 7:47 Oh, one more thing. Not a problem, just a question. Our compliance team is asking about the QM scorecard change log. They want to know who changed what and when. Is that something we can pull?

turns.speaker: unknown
turns.text: [PERSON_1] 7:59 I believe there's an audit trail in the QM admin settings. I can double-check and send you the steps.

turns.speaker: unknown
turns.text: [PERSON_3] 8:06 That'd be great. They review every scorecard change, so they just want to have a record.

turns.speaker: unknown
turns.text: [PERSON_1] 8:12 Makes sense. I'll send that over. I mean, Anything else?

turns.speaker: unknown
turns.text: [PERSON_2] 8:17 No, I think that covers it. [PERSON_1], I appreciate you getting ahead of this. The board stuff is real, but I don't want to make it a bigger deal than it is.

turns.speaker: unknown
turns.text: [PERSON_1] 8:32 Of course. I'd rather know now than in February. Let me recap what I'm taking away: the QM value one-pager, the spam tagging examples from [PERSON_3], the Salesforce cases from [PERSON_4], and the QM audit trail steps. I'll follow up by Monday with next steps on all of it.

turns.speaker: unknown
turns.text: [PERSON_2] 8:51 Perfect. And hey, if you're ever up in Gig Harbor, let me know. I'll buy you a coffee at the new branch.

turns.speaker: unknown
turns.text: [PERSON_1] 9:00 You know, I might take you up on that. I've heard the views are great.

turns.speaker: unknown
turns.text: [PERSON_3] 9:07 They are. On a clear day you can see the water.

turns.speaker: unknown
turns.text: [PERSON_4] 9:11 Clear day in October. Good luck.

turns.speaker: unknown
turns.text: [PERSON_2] 9:14 Ha, fair. Alright, thanks everyone. Talk soon.

turns.speaker: unknown
turns.text: [PERSON_1] 9:17 Thanks, all. Have a good one.
